Kuṭanaṭhamudgara(kuṣṭhamudgara_?)
med. ACW. 162.

Kuṭilācārya
--Tattvapañcāśikā. BORI. 833 of 1887-91. [Page175-b]

Kuṭumbakavi
--Prastāva(pra)bandha. Q. by Raghunātha Paṇḍita Manohara in Kavikaustubha, Doṣaprakaraṇa. JOR. Madras, XXVIII. p. 118; Poona Ori. VII. p. 160.

Kuṭṭanīmata
also called zambhalImata advice of a bawd; erotico-satirical an. didactic poem in about 1000 Āryā verses. by Dāmodaragupta, ref. to by Kalhaṇa (Rājataraṅgiṇī, IV. 496) a. a poet, a. of Kuṭṭanīmata an. minister of King Jayāpīḍa of Kashmir (779-813 A. D.). The text refers to the performance of Harṣa's Ratnāvali by a troupe of women actors.
Q. by Mammaṭa an. Ruyyaka, an. in various anthologies. For a list of q.s. from it in anthologies, see F. W. Thomas, Kvs. 46. Also Peters. II. p.. 23-33 for a. analysis of the contents.
Cambr. p. 19. Jainagranthāvalī p. 363. Pattan I. p. 99. Peters. I. Intro. p. 65. App. p.. 19-20 (no. 34) (called Sumbhalīmata). PUL. II. p. 252 (inc.). RASB. VII. 5085. 5086 (d. 1172 A. D.). Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 7. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 72 (no. 600).
See Poona Ori. XV. p. 94.
Pt.. (1) K. M. Gucch. III. Bombay, 1887. (2) Ed. with Skt. C. Rasakallola by T. M. Tripathi, Guj. Pr. Press, Bombay, 1924. (3) Transl. in German by J. J. Meyer, Leipzig, 1903. (5) with Bengali transl. in Bengali script. Calcutta, 1954.

Kuṭṭākāraśiromaṇi
with C. jy. by Devarāja of Atrigotra, son of Varadācārya alias [Page176-a. Siddhāntavallabha. Burnell 76a. Mysore I. p.. 332 (with C.). 643 (2 mss.). TD. 11355 (inc.). This is a. exposition of the two sūtras on the subject in Āryabhaṭīya.
Pt.. Ānandāśrama 125.

Kuṭṭākāraśiromaṇi
jy. dedicated to Vijayarāghava, the fourth Nāyaka ruler of Tanjore. by Veṅkaṭādri (who appears to be same a. Bhūgola Veṅkaṭeśa). TD. 11354 (inc.) (with C.).
--C. Ṭīkā. a.. TD. 11354 (inc.) (with text).

Kuṭṭākārādigaṇita
jy. Trav. Uni. 14076D. L. 1337B (inc.).

Kuṭṭikavi
popular name of Vāñcheśvara I or Vāñchānātha, a. of Mahiṣaśataka, Turagaśataka an. Aśīrvādaśataka; an. great grandfather of Vāñcheśvara II (a. of C. Bhāṭṭacintāmaṇi on Bhāṭṭadīpikā, Adyar D. IX. 213).
His great grandson an. commentator an. a. of Bhāṭṭacintāmaṇi was also called Kuṭṭikavi or K. Śāstri.
See Skt. Intro. to the edn. of Bhāṭṭacintāmaṇi, M. L. J. Press, Madras, 1934; P. K. Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. II. p.. 499-511.

Kuṭṭima
